description:
You will support design, develop and improve client's largest internal engineering data management system that manage/track virtually all the client products' (IPs, SOCs, Platforms, embedded devices...etc.) information/operations worldwide. Analyze user requirements, writing design specifications and implementing the solution. Your responsibilities will include but not be limited to: applying judgment in data analysis to develop and design solutions for complex processes according to the requirements and specifications, performing unit and integration testing; planning and scheduling work to meet deadlines; exploring new technology alternatives to solve problems.

 Master degree in Computer Science with 5+ years or Bachelor degree in Computer Science with 7+ years of industry experience.
 Proven track record of design and develop 3-tier Web applications  
 Knowledge and hands-on experience of build application based on MVC framework/model  
 Experience in Angular JS, JavaScript, UIKit, or Google Web Toolkit  
 Knowledge and development skills in relational databases (such as Microsoft SQL) and TSQL (Transactional SQL)  
 Strong Object Oriented design and programming skills, C#, Java  
 Cross platform knowledge in MS and Linux 
 SW engineering development practice and discipline (from Traditional to Agile methodology) and strong programming and scripting languages (e.g. Perl) skills
